data.songTitle: Last Thing You Need (from GTAVI: The Album)
data.albumName: Last Thing You Need (from GTAVI: The Album)
data.plainLyric:
The last thing you said to me
"If I don't leave now, then I never will
I miss you, but I gotta see
How somebody good for me feels"

You took off your dress and said, "One more night"
Head on my chest, though I felt you cry
And I took my time with what we had left
Then you said, "Goodbye," and baby, I said

"You know where I am, you know where I'll be
Whenever you want the last thing you need
When you miss the hands that know how to speak
Bad for your heart and good for your sheets
Keep saying that it's over now
Girl, I ain't gonna slow you down
But you know where I am, you know where I'll be
Whenever you want the last thing you need
The last thing"

Last thing I'm meant to do
Was be the best you ever had in your memory
And if you find somebody new
And think he needs a new enemy

Girl, come take off your dress and stay one more night
Head on my chest, a lot on your mind
Stay 'til the sun and make a mistake
You say it's just once but girl, if it ain't

You know where I am, you know where I'll be
Whenever you want the last thing you need
When you miss the hands that know how to speak
Bad for your heart and good for your sheets
Keep saying that it's over now
Girl, I ain't gonna slow you down
But you know where I am, you know where I'll be
Whenever you want the last thing you need
The last thing

I know I should do you a favor
Draw the line and make you a stranger
But I can't, girl
If it's tomorrow night or in another life

You know where I am, you know where I'll be
Whenever you want the last thing you need
When you miss the hands that know how to speak
Bad for your heart and good for your sheets
Keep saying that it's over now
Girl, I ain't gonna slow you down
But you know where I am, you know where I'll be
Whenever you want the last thing you need
The last thing

The last thing
Yeah, you know where I am, you know where I'll be
Whenever you want the last thing you need
The last thing
